verdict.rationale: Smithery documents auto-generated typed TypeScript SDKs for every published MCP server and REST/SDK-style integration with the Vercel AI SDK, which supports building against official SDKs. However, evidence is limited to TypeScript and one framework integration, there's no broader multi-language SDK documentation, no OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404s), and no independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK quality or completeness. missing for 10: multi-language SDK support, public OpenAPI/API reference, independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
